description: MP-02 is a specialized registration code reserved exclusively for vehicles owned and operated by the Madhya Pradesh State Government. Unlike standard city-based RTOs, this code is used for the official government fleet and is centrally administered through the state's transport infrastructure in the capital city.
address: Regional Transport Office, Shivaji Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

description: MP-03 is a specialized registration code reserved exclusively for vehicles owned and operated by the Madhya Pradesh Police Department. Unlike standard district codes, this series is active state-wide for the police fleet and is administratively managed from the state capital, Bhopal.
address: Regional Transport Office, No. 6 Locality, Shivaji Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

description: The MP-04 RTO serves the capital city of Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, and is responsible for vehicle registration and driving licenses for the district. It is the first numerical code assigned to a general administrative district in the state, following the reserved codes for high-level officials and police. The office plays a critical role in managing urban transport and enforcing motor vehicle regulations in the state capital.
address: MPRTC Building, Behind Mansarovar Complex, 7 Number Stop, Shivaji Nagar, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh

description: The MP-05 RTO serves the Narmadapuram district, formerly known as Hoshangabad, which is a major administrative hub in central Madhya Pradesh. It is a vital office for vehicle registration and licensing within the Narmada valley region, handling heavy traffic due to its proximity to the Itarsi railway junction.
address: MPSRTC Bus Stand, Near Satrasta RTO Office, Narmadapuram, Madhya Pradesh

description: The RTO Morena (MP-06) is a vital Regional Transport Office serving the Morena district within the Chambal division. It is responsible for motor vehicle registrations, issuance of driving licenses, and enforcement of the Motor Vehicles Act along the Mumbai-Agra National Highway (NH-3).
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Chonda Toll Tax, Mumbai-Agra National Highway (A.B. Road), Morena, Madhya Pradesh

description: MP-07 is the Regional Transport Office serving Gwalior, a major historical and administrative city in Madhya Pradesh. This RTO is responsible for vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and enforcing road safety regulations within the Gwalior district.
address: Regional Transport Office, Near Police Station, Aamkho Road, Vakil Colony, Kampoo, Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh

description: The MP-08 Regional Transport Office serves the Guna district in Madhya Pradesh, managing vehicle registrations, driving licenses, and transport permits. It is a key administrative hub for road safety and transport regulation in the Gwalior division.
address: Regional Transport Office, Model Town Colony, Guna, Madhya Pradesh 473001

description: MP-09 is the Regional Transport Office for Indore, the largest city and commercial hub of Madhya Pradesh. It is responsible for vehicle registrations, issuing driving licenses, and enforcing transport regulations across one of Central India's most significant urban and industrial corridors.
address: RTO Office, Nayta Mundla, Indore, Madhya Pradesh
